movie.title: The Theft of the Caravaggio
movie.overview: Orpheus wakes to discover a priceless Caravaggio painting stolen from St. John's Cathedral in Valletta while under his watch. With the city on edge, a detective is brought in from Washington to aid the local police in solving the case.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a priceless Caravaggio painting is stolen under guard Orpheus's watch in Valletta, an American detective joins forces with local police to solve the high-stakes heist.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Guard Orpheus awakes to a nightmare when a priceless Caravaggio masterpiece vanishes from St. John's Cathedral in Valletta during his shift. To tackle the escalating crisis and ease the panicked city, a seasoned Washington detective is flown in to assist local Maltese authorities. Together, they must navigate a web of secrets, local tensions, and shadowy motives to recover the stolen treasure. As the investigation deepens, time runs out to unmask the mastermind behind the daring crime.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the historic city of Valletta, security guard Orpheus awakens from an unexplained lapse to find St. John's Cathedral stripped of its most revered possession: a priceless Caravaggio masterpiece. The shocking theft sends shockwaves through the local community and puts high-ranking officials under immense pressure to solve the case. Desperate for answers and lacking specialized art-crime expertise, the local police force welcomes an unexpected ally—a sharp detective dispatched all the way from Washington. As the outsider collaborates with the Maltese law enforcement team, they encounter conflicting testimony, guarded motives, and growing suspicion directed at Orpheus himself. The investigators dive into Valletta's underbelly and high-society art rings, tracing subtle clues left behind at the crime scene. Tensions rise as cultural differences and tight deadlines test the fragile partnership between the local officers and the visiting American detective. Every lead uncovers deeper deception, suggesting the heist was an inside job executed with surgical precision. Ultimately, the team must piece together the truth behind Orpheus's lost memory and track down the masterpiece before it vanishes into the global black market forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Theft of the Caravaggio is a tense crime drama set against the breathtaking backdrop of Valletta, Malta. The story kicks off with a catastrophic security breach: Orpheus, a security guard tasked with protecting St. John's Cathedral, wakes up to discover that a world-renowned Caravaggio painting has been brazenly stolen under his watch. With the local populace in an uproar and pressure mounting from international authorities, local police join forces with a skilled detective brought in from Washington, D.C. The narrative weaves an intricate mystery as the unlikely team tackles secretive art markets, conflicting alibis, and personal betrayal, striving to retrieve the priceless artifact before it disappears permanently.
